legacy_design.title: An automation runs from an older designer source
legacy_design.description: An automation for {name} still carries the designer source (design) that an older release saved. It keeps working, but the designer now saves only the payload. Open the automation in the ESL Manager and save it again to replace the source with a payload. Parts a payload cannot follow (field templates, binary and weather icon rules, sensor templates, data fields with two or more decimals) are fixed at their current value when saved, and a weather forecast or an angle that is not a multiple of 90° must first become a template or a quarter turn. You can leave such an automation as it is. This notice goes away when Home Assistant restarts.
